displayName: Warzone 2100 preserving WZ Save As writer

notes: Its selected multiplay/maps/2c-highground/game.map source is independently pinned as sha256:c03e17c13a837339a1b8066047385758539cdc14ef903d806fcf871d30409111.
An unchanged complete canonical data/mp.wz Save As is byte-identical; typed tile and existing-gateway edits replace only that existing game.map payload.
All untouched canonical ZIP entry blocks and the archive comment are preserved by the common ZIP writer.

limitations: Export-only Save As accepts one complete SHA-256-bound classic canonical .wz snapshot, one exact existing game.map path and a separately revision-pinned destination namespace.
The nested typed edit surface is limited to tile texture/height and existing gateway coordinate updates.
Duplicate or case-fold-ambiguous paths, shadowed last-wins entries, encryption, ZIP64, unsafe or non-canonical ZIP layouts fail closed.
The common ZIP writer stores the changed game.map entry and preserves all untouched canonical entry blocks without recompression.
Adding, deleting or renaming entries, changing other map companions, signatures, multi-package VFS overlays and in-place writes remain unavailable.
